landing.title: The working record of a scientific meeting.
landing.lede: PapersManagement supports authors, reviewers, committees and organisers: submission, review, decisions, program and publication — ready for a full local demo.

authors.title: Authors
authors.body: Submissions, revisions, camera-ready files, and copyright steps live in one paper workspace.

reviewers.title: Reviewers
reviewers.body: Assignments stay limited to invited papers, with separate comments for authors and the committee.

committees.title: Committees
committees.body: Chairs and administrators share a conference, with scientific decisions kept apart from office administration.

health.title: API status

workspace.notAuthenticated: This control does not grant access.

author.title: Author workspace
author.intro: A place for your manuscripts, revision requests, and publication tasks. The counters below are not live.

reviewer.title: Reviewer workspace

committee.title: Scientific committee

administrator.title: Conference administration
administrator.intro: Conference setup, memberships, and document checks will be managed here, separately from scientific decisions.

system.title: Platform administration
system.intro: System-wide configuration will be limited, separate from any one conference, and audited. It is not available in this phase.

planned.title: This module is not available yet

registrationPage.title: Registration and payment
registrationPage.intro: Registration and payment are done in each accepted paper dossier (Registration step), not on a separate page.
registrationPage.empty: Open an accepted submission to complete registration and payment.

followUp.title: Publication

papers.title: Submissions
papers.intro: Deposit and workflow until publication: draft, PDF, submit, review, camera ready. Already published papers (DOI) are in Publication.
papers.noneMatch: No submission matches this filter or search.
papers.kindHint: Upload both the abstract and the regular paper on this first step.

papers.detailsHint: Title, theme, abstract, and both PDFs.

papers.fileHint: PDF only, up to 20 MB. The file stays in private storage.
papers.submitHint: Submitting freezes the manuscript. Withdrawal is the only later change in this phase.
papers.failed: The submission could not be saved.

sessionBoard.intro: Create a session (with its room), place accepted papers, then assign a session chair.

sessionBoard.sessionEmptyForChair: Place papers in this session first, then assign the chair.

assignments.title: Assign papers to reviewers

assignments.allFailed: No invitation could be sent (conflict or already assigned).

reviews.title: Review invitations
reviews.intro: Accept a review, then send a score from 1 to 10 and comments. Committee notes stay hidden from authors.
reviews.rereviewHint: The author uploaded a corrected version. Accept it, or ask for more modifications.
reviews.awaitingRevision: Waiting for the author’s revised file
reviews.inboxHint: One paper per line. Open a line to accept, write, or read that review only.
reviews.noneMatch: No review matches this filter or search.

reviews.formOnReviewsPage: The full form (score, confidence, comments) is on this review’s page.
reviews.assignIntro: Only submitted papers can be assigned. A conflict of interest or an existing active assignment is rejected.

reviewers.manageIntro: Create a reviewer account, give them the email and password, then assign papers from the submission dossier.
reviewers.manageOnly: Only a conference admin can create reviewers here.
reviewers.accountsEmpty: No reviewer account yet. Create one to assign papers.
